data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this supports $10,000 per fisher every month indefinitely. Larger collective catches risk shrinking next month's stock or collapse. I intend to request 10 and ask everyone to make the same voluntary commitment; revealed catches can guide future coordination.
